newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPC aborts sale to South Korea's Sungwoo.
newsitem.headline: IPC aborts sale to South Korea's Sungwoo.

text.p: IPC Corp said on Wednesday it was aborting its agreement to sell 66 million shares in the company to South Korea's Sungwoo Group.
"We are making the termination today," chairman Patrick Ngiam told reporters at a briefing.
He said the agreement was terminated because the Sungwoo Group was not able to obtain approval from the South Korean government.

He said that IPC would look for another company to buy the stake if the opportunity was right, but for now the company sees that it has sufficent funds for its business requirements from its proposed rights issue announced earlier.
